correctness.rationale: On the ordinary OPEN neighborhood complex of Q_d (d>=4), every simplex has one parity and every face of size >=3 lies in one cube-neighbor facet. Per-facet collapses to triangles anchored at coordinate 1 produce a 2-dimensional parity component whose 1-skeleton contains a cube-graph generating system; the retained triangles fill coordinate squares and prove pi1=0. A nonzero binary translation can fix a realization point only by stabilizing a support face, hence containing a pair of vertices at Hamming distance wt(c); such a pair shares a common graph neighbor exactly for wt(c)=2. This establishes sharp free iff condition. Even code E acts freely on the simply connected component, so its quotient has deck group E and H1=E. Equivariant descent of the anchor collapse yields a 2D CW spine; H2 is integral-free, higher homology zero, and chi/|E| fixes its rank. Odd codewords exchange parity components. Independently checked f-vectors/Euler for d=4,5,6, but finite tests do not establish any higher d.
